introHtml: Orange lip balm stands out in a crowd, making it a memorable choice for trade shows and promotional events. The bright, cheerful color pairs well with summer campaigns or wellness kits. Whether you choose a squeeze tube with a key ring for easy carry or a Sun Bum® kit for a trusted brand, custom imprinting on the tube or ball ensures your logo stays visible. Bulk orders keep costs low while delivering a useful, everyday item that recipients will reach for again and again.
